customers_say: Customers find this water purifier to be one of the best smart RO units in its price range, with excellent performance and easy installation that goes smoothly without hassle. The water quality receives positive feedback, with one customer noting TDS levels below 100, and customers appreciate its appearance, with one highlighting the modern touch panel with LED indicators. While the service offers 2 years of hassle-free maintenance, several customers report reliability issues, with units stopping working within one month of use.

reviews.title: Value for money and quality of water is good.
reviews.body: Product delivery took some time, but installation took place on the second day, installation process was smooth, technician done a wonderful job. Quality of water is good and very tasty, tds level came down to around 40-50 ppm. Got inbuilt battery just to dispense water incase of power cut, purifier doesn't run with that battery.
